column3: note
The Empire is governed from here.
The Alliance is governed from here.
Hutton Orbital is out here, 0.22 light years from the arrival star — about ninety minutes at full throttle, and the longest supercruise anybody makes on purpose.
Sixty-five thousand light years out, near the far rim. It was Ceeckia ZQ-L c24-0 until Frontier renamed it for the Commanders who got here first.
Jaques Station misjumped to here in 3302 and never left. The whole region grew around it.
One of the most massive stars known, and it is shedding itself into the nebula around it.
Two black holes, and the more massive of them is the heaviest stellar black hole known.
John Jameson's Cobra Mark Three came down on the first planet's moon B and is still there — the wreck every Commander eventually visits.
Thargoid surface sites, and the system Azimuth fired the Proteus Wave in.
One of the Old Worlds — Lave, Leesti, Diso and Zaonce were the first systems humanity settled beyond Sol, colonised in the 25th century.
Darnielle's Progress, on Maia A 2 A, is where meta-alloys can be bought rather than harvested.
The first Thargoid barnacle anybody found was on Merope 5 C, in 3302.
Settled from the Old Worlds in the wave after Lave's, and the one with the reputation. Commanders have been warning each other about Riedquat for a very long time.
The supermassive black hole at the centre of the galaxy.
Founders World, and Jameson Memorial above it. The Pilots Federation's home, and the permit arrives with an Elite rank.
Sirius Corporation was founded here, and still keeps its headquarters in the system.
Earth is here. Everywhere else on this list is somewhere humanity got to afterwards.
Explorer's Anchorage — the starport furthest from Sol, built where the expeditions stop.
The first Guardian ruins ever found, on the first planet's moon B, in October 3302.
The megaship Zurara is derelict above the first planet — the far end of the Formidine Rift mystery, and its crew's logs are still aboard.
